issues.explanation: Invite form shows @error('inviteRole') only; no @error('inviteEmail') block, so an inviteEmail validation failure renders zero help is-danger elements instead of exactly one.
Domain writes (invites()->create, EntityMembership::firstOrCreate, invite delete) are done directly in Livewire components instead of going through app/Actions/* as conventions require.

Server-only state selectedMembershipId (?int) and confirmingRemoval (bool) are public but not #[Locked]; client can rewrite them and saveRole/confirm flows rely only on entity-scoped findOrFail for mitigation.
memberRole has no #[Validate] attribute (inline Rule::in in saveRole only) and PendingInvites actions use manual e-mail abort_unless instead of $this->authorize policy/gate.

Member modal header adds id="member-modal-title" versus the task contract

{{ __('ui.members_details') }}

; functionally equivalent but not exact.

conventions.evidence: #[Validate]+validate() used for invites, policies via authorize() in Members, generated migration with down(), audit logging, docs/CHANGELOG updated; but domain writes bypass app/Actions/* and selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval lack #[Locked], memberRole lacks #[Validate]

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:300 managerCount(), small focused sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole/confirmRemoval methods; Blade uses semantic Bulma modal markup with aria labels

requirements.evidence: EntityInvite model/casts/normalization, invites table+unique, sendInvite validation/pending-replace/race-catch/rate-limit/mail/audit, PendingInvites accept/decline/idempotent/redirect, switcher+onboarding <hr> logic, mail markdown/keys all present; but members.blade.php invite form has no @error('inviteEmail') so 'exactly once help is-danger' fails

scope.evidence: Diff touches only invites model/mail/factory/migration, Members/PendingInvites components+views, switcher/onboarding/dashboard/navbar manager gating, lang/docs/tests; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Members mount/sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole/removeMember authorize server-side, inputs validated, {{ }} escaping, mass-assignment deliberate, race caught as inviteEmail error; gap is unlocked public IDs and manual e-mail check in PendingInvites instead of policy, both mitigated by entity scoping

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Entity::invites(), scopePending/scopeForEmail, managerCount() helper, existing x-input/x-label/mail theme; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/InviteTest.php + MembersTest.php cover schema/unique/factory/expired/normalization/cascade, mail EN/pt_BR rendering, pending list filtering, accept/redirect/idempotent/owner-downgrade/decline, invite validation/member/pending/expired/race/rate-limit/single-error render, cancel scoping, modal open/foreign/tamper/saveRole/last-manager/removal modal

review.summary: Implements invite-only membership end-to-end (model, migration, mail, Members + PendingInvites flows, manager-only gating, modals, langs, docs, extensive Pest tests). Needs changes before merging: the invite e-mail validation error is not rendered, plus Livewire convention gaps (unlocked IDs, no Actions, manual invitee check).
